Section 7.7 requires the licensee to indemnify, defend, and hold DeepSeek and specified related parties harmless for qualifying third-party claims. No available activity/object combination represents this indemnity obligation faithfully; it is not a Use permission.

Section 9(e)(ii)(D) excludes the Copyright Assurance for Claims resulting from finetuning or Modifications of the Cohere Products. This limits an indemnification remedy, not an enumerated activity.
